stories.text: 🪦 The eulogy is in: In My Fantasy Era gets its send-off (15.39 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Ruffing the Passer vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Ruffing the Passer 45% / 21%, Mr. Action Jackson 89% / 67%.
🎯 TWO WINS: Ruffing the Passer: 48% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 33%).
📈 LINE MOVE: JAX @ BAL: BAL −4.5 at open, JAX −10 now. News: "Rookie Joe Fagnano to start Thursday night vs. Jaguars, Jesse Minter says"
📈 LINE MOVE: NYG @ PHI: PHI −5.5 at open, NYG −3.5 now. 2 league starters in it, led by S. Barkley (Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy).
🏟️ Game to watch: JAX @ BAL (Thursday 8:15 PM), 9 league starters in action with 90.16 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (JAX @ BAL): 9 league starters in action. Most riding on it: Kirbo Crushers vs Brock You Like a Hurricane (33.73 pts projected).
🔁 In hindsight: If The Mahomies and Gibb it to Me Baby had swapped Metcalf and Williams for Stevenson and Collins back in Week 5, both would be ahead.
🤝 Rivalry week: Ramosverse leads TDsMaGee 5–2 all-time.
🎤 BYE BYE BYE: The Mahomies has 2 starters on bye this week (Metcalf and Boswell). Somebody call *NSYNC.
🔁 Retro trade: If TDsMaGee and Gibb it to Me Baby had swapped Michael Wilson for Quinshon Judkins back in Week 5, both would be ahead (+2 wins each).
🛍️ Ruffing the Passer went waiver shopping: Adonai Mitchell and J.J. McCarthy. Retail therapy.
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 11% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted The Mahomies after the favorite flipped 5 times.
